stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 时态(复习 + 过去将来时)

units.grammarTitle: 时态(复习 + 过去将来时)

writing.prompt: Write a short passage of about 100 words describing your ideal school life. Include: 1) the courses or way of learning you would like; 2) the school activities or clubs you want to take part in; 3) what kind of classmates and teacher-student relationship you hope for; 4) how this school life would make you feel. Use tenses correctly (present / future) and keep every sentence on topic.
writing.promptCn: 上外版必修一 Unit 1 写作任务。请用英语写一篇约100词的短文,描述你理想的学校生活,内容包括:① 理想的课程或学习方式;② 你想参加的校园活动或社团;③ 你希望拥有怎样的同学与师生关系;④ 这样的学校生活会给你怎样的感受。注意:用时态正确(现在/将来),句子地道、围绕中心。

finalReading.passage: On her first morning at senior high, Mia felt so nervous that her hands shook while she looked for her classroom. A friendly senior student noticed her and kindly walked her to the right room. By the end of that day, Mia had already made two new friends and could not stop smiling on her way home.

questions.q: How did Mia feel at the very start of her first morning?
options: Anxious and unsure of where to go.
Calm and full of confidence.
Bored and uninterested.
Angry at her new teachers.
questions.explanation: 原文她紧张到手发抖、在找教室,转述其焦虑;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What happened to Mia by the end of the day?
options: She had made new friends and felt happy.
She decided to leave the school.
She lost her way home.
She still knew nobody.
questions.explanation: 末句她已交到两个新朋友、回家一路微笑(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置),转述其结果。

units.title: Language and Culture
units.grammarTitle: 基本句型(Basic Sentence Patterns)

writing.prompt: Suppose some students from your sister school abroad are visiting your school, and you are asked to give a short talk about "Chinese words and their stories". Write a short passage (about 80 words) to introduce one Chinese word (e.g. "chi"). Include: 1) a clear topic sentence (the word has many extended meanings); 2) two or three examples showing it goes beyond its literal meaning; 3) a brief note on the culture behind the word. Make sure every supporting sentence relates to the topic sentence and your pronouns are clear.
writing.promptCn: 假设来自姐妹学校的外国学生正在参观你校,你被邀请做一个关于"汉语词及其故事"的小演讲。请用英语写一篇约80词的短文,介绍一个汉语词(如"吃 chi"),内容包括:① 一个清楚的主题句(这个词有很多引申含义);② 两三个例子说明它超出字面意思;③ 简述这个词背后的文化。注意:所有支撑句都要围绕主题句,代词指代清楚。

finalReading.passage: When Mark first lived in Spain, he was puzzled that people said "in a minute" but often kept him waiting for an hour. Instead of getting angry, he slowly learned that the words were not meant to be taken literally. A year later, he no longer panicked about small delays, and he felt much more relaxed about time than he had ever been at home.

questions.q: Why was Mark puzzled at first?
options: Locals promised something soon, yet made him wait far longer.
He could not find any food in Spain.
Nobody in Spain could speak English.
He had lost his way in the city.
questions.explanation: 原文 'said "in a minute" but often kept him waiting for an hour' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Mark feel about time a year later?
options: Angrier than before.
Much more relaxed about small delays.
Sorry that he had moved there.
Too worried to leave home.
questions.explanation: 末句 'no longer panicked… felt much more relaxed about time'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)的转述。

units.title: Travel
units.grammarTitle: 状语从句复习(Adverbial Clauses)

writing.prompt: Suppose your Canadian friend Chris is planning a trip to China this December. Write an email (about 80 words) to recommend a city and make a three-day travel plan for him, including: 1) the city you recommend and why (history, scenery or food); 2) a rough plan for the three days (attractions, food, shopping, etc.); 3) one line of encouragement or good wishes. Try to use some adverbial clauses to link your ideas.
writing.promptCn: 假设你的加拿大朋友 Chris 计划今年十二月来中国旅行。请给他写一封约80词的电子邮件,为他推荐一座城市并拟一份三天的旅行计划,内容包括:① 推荐的城市及推荐理由(历史/风景/美食);② 三天的大致安排(景点、美食、购物等);③ 一句鼓励或祝愿。注意:适当使用状语从句使行文连贯。

finalReading.passage: Last winter Liam joined a student exchange and spent two weeks in a small town in the south. At first he felt shy because he knew no one there, but his host family was so kind that he soon felt at home. By the end of the trip, he had made new friends and learned far more about real life than any book had taught him.

questions.q: Why did Liam feel shy at the beginning?
options: He did not know anyone in the town yet.
He had lost all his money.
He could not find the host family.
He disliked the cold winter.
questions.explanation: 原文 'he felt shy because he knew no one there' 的转述;其余与原文不符。

questions.q: What did Liam gain by the end of the trip?
options: A free plane ticket home.
New friends and real-life knowledge.
A job in the small town.
A large suitcase of souvenirs.
questions.explanation: 末句 'made new friends and learned far more about real life'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Customs and Traditions

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 被动语态复习(+ 现在进行被动 + 现在完成被动)

units.grammarTitle: 被动语态复习(+ 现在进行被动 + 现在完成被动)

writing.prompt: Your school is holding a coming-of-age ceremony, and a group of American high-school students are coming to visit. Write a paragraph of about 80 words to introduce one Chinese coming-of-age ceremony (such as the ancient hair-pinning or capping ceremony) to them. Include: 1) when and for whom it is held; 2) the main activities; 3) its meaning. Begin with a topic sentence, keep all supporting sentences on one idea, and finish with a concluding sentence.
writing.promptCn: 你校正在举办成人礼,一群来自美国高中的学生前来参观。请你用英语写一段约80词的介绍,向美国学生介绍一种中国的成人礼(如古代的笄礼或冠礼),内容包括:① 它在什么时候、为谁举行;② 主要的庆祝活动或环节;③ 它的意义。注意:用一个主题句开头,支撑句围绕中心,用一个结尾句收束,保持段落统一。

finalReading.passage: On a small island in the South Pacific, young boys come of age by jumping from a tall wooden tower with a vine tied to their ankles. Before the very first jump, the boy's mother holds an object that stands for his childhood, and after he lands the object is thrown away. In this brave way, the boys show that they are ready to leave childhood behind and become men.

questions.q: How do the boys on the island come of age?
options: By leaping off a high tower while a vine holds their ankles.
By writing a long letter to their parents.
By staying quietly at home for a year.
By giving away all of their toys.
questions.explanation: 原文 'jumping from a tall wooden tower with a vine tied to their ankles' 的转述;其余与原文不符。

questions.q: What does throwing the object away stand for?
options: That the family has become rich.
That the boy is leaving childhood behind.
That the jump has been cancelled.
That the mother wants a new gift.
questions.explanation: 末句 'show that they are ready to leave childhood behind' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Nature

lines.text: Are you free this Saturday? I'm planning to go hiking in the hills.
lines.cn: 这周六你有空吗?我打算去山里爬山。

lines.text: That sounds great. I really need some time in nature.
lines.cn: 听起来太好了。我真的需要一些亲近自然的时间。

lines.text: Let's be quiet so we don't frighten the animals.
lines.cn: 我们小声点,免得惊扰了动物。

lines.text: Good idea. And we must take all our rubbish home.
lines.cn: 好主意。还有,我们得把垃圾全带回家。

units.grammarTitle: 定语从句1(who/whom/that/which/whose)

reading.passage: Every spring our class plants young trees on a bare hillside that people once cut for wood. The work is tiring, but we feel proud to be helping the earth. Our teacher says nature cannot be rushed, yet every small tree is a sign of hope.
reading.passageCn: 每年春天,我们班都会在一片曾被人砍光取材的光秃山坡上种小树。劳动很累,但能为地球出力让我们感到自豪。老师说自然不能急于求成,但每一棵小树都是希望的象征。

questions.q: What had people once done to the hillside?
How do the students feel about the work?
opts: Proud to be helping the earth.

writing.prompt: Write about 80 words describing a scene in nature you like, in spatial order (from near to far). End with how it makes you feel.
writing.promptCn: 用约80词按空间顺序(由近及远)描写一处你喜欢的自然景色,结尾写出它给你的感受。

quizQuestions.q: The protection of the natural environment is called ____.
Animals in a zoo must ____ to a climate that is not their own.
Clean water is ____ for every living thing.
Pollution is a serious ____ to wild plants and animals.
The young man ____ explained the mystery had grown up near the gardens.
The old tree ____ stood in the middle of the gardens was cut down.
The king offered a reward to anyone ____ solution would be effective.
These were the bones on ____ ancient symbols had been carved.
听句子选中文:
opts: 保护蜜蜂就是保护一个健康的世界。
quizQuestions.audio: Protecting bees means protecting a healthy world for us all.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 动物园展出来自各地的动物。
quizQuestions.audio: Restoring nature takes many years.

listeningQuestions.audio: Many rare plants are now close to extinction.
opts: 许多稀有植物如今濒临灭绝。
许多城市的人口正在增长。
许多孩子喜欢去公园玩。
许多商店今天都关门了。

listeningQuestions.audio: We must protect nature for future generations.
opts: 我们应该多读一些好书。
我们必须为子孙后代保护自然。
我们需要更努力地学习。

listeningQuestions.audio: The balance of nature is delicate and easy to break.
opts: 自然的平衡很脆弱,容易被打破。

listeningQuestions.audio: Time in nature has a positive effect on our minds.
opts: 亲近自然对我们的心灵有积极影响。
城市里的交通非常拥挤。
他每天都录下自己的声音。
这些花原产于这个地区。

listeningQuestions.audio: It is cruel to keep wild animals in small cages.
opts: 把野生动物关在小笼子里很残忍。
这座动物园离市中心很远。
孩子们正在公园里植树。
蜜蜂帮助植物结出果实。

listeningQuestions.audio: Even a badly damaged river can be restored with care.
opts: 即使严重受损的河流也能被精心修复。
森林里住着许多稀有的鸟。
我们应该把垃圾带回家。

finalReading.passage: In a small valley, an old farmer let one corner of his field grow wild. Soon insects, birds and rare flowers returned to that little patch, and the whole farm seemed more alive. He often smiled and said that giving nature a small space had brought the balance of life back to his land.

questions.q: What did the farmer do with one corner of his field?
options: He let it grow wild instead of using it.
He covered it with stones.
He sold it to a neighbour.
He built a small house on it.
questions.explanation: 原文 'let one corner of his field grow wild' 的转述;其余与原文不符或未提。

questions.q: What did the farmer believe this had done for his land?
options: It had made his land smaller.
It had restored the natural balance to his farm.
It had driven the birds away.
It had ruined his crops.
questions.explanation: 末句 'giving nature a small space had brought the balance of life back' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Animals

lines.text: Did you enjoy our trip to the zoo today?
lines.cn: 你喜欢今天的动物园之行吗?

lines.text: I did, but some cages looked quite small, and that made me a little sad.
lines.cn: 喜欢,不过有些笼子看起来挺小的,这让我有点难过。

lines.text: I know, but this zoo really focuses on the animals' welfare and joins many conservation projects.
lines.cn: 我懂,但这家动物园很重视动物福利,还参与许多保护项目。

lines.text: Then I'm glad we came. Overall, a good zoo can be a caring place.
lines.cn: 那我很高兴我们来了。总体来说,好的动物园是个有爱的地方。

units.grammarTitle: 定语从句2(when/where/why · 介词+which)

reading.passage: Salty was a guide dog who calmly led his blind owner down seventy flights of stairs to safety. For their courage, both the dog and the owner later received special awards.
reading.passageCn: 萨尔蒂是一只导盲犬,它沉着地带着失明的主人沿七十层楼梯走到安全地带。因为这份勇气,这只狗和主人后来都获得了特别的奖励。

questions.q: What did Salty do for his owner?
opts: Led him safely down the stairs.

questions.q: Why did the dog and owner receive awards?

writing.prompt: Write a short opinion paragraph (about 80 words) on whether students should feed homeless cats on campus. State your view, give a reason, and suggest a better way such as contacting a rescue centre.
writing.promptCn: 就'学生是否该在校园喂流浪猫'写一段约80词的观点段落:表明你的观点,给出一条理由,并提出一个更妥当的做法(如联系救助中心)。

quizQuestions.q: Because of illegal hunting, some animals may become ____ and disappear forever.
Zoos take part in many ____ projects to protect rare animals.
The old man tried to ____ the penguin back into the sea, but it would not leave.
A trip to a good zoo can be both fun and ____.
This is the island ____ the old man set the penguin free.
Spring is the season ____ many birds fly back to build their nests.
There are many reasons ____ we should protect endangered animals.
That is the small boat in ____ he carried the penguin to the island.
听录音,选出与句意相符的一项。
opts: 不同文化对同一种动物的看法可能不同。
所有国家都把狗当作家人。
在印度,牛被当作肉的来源。
所有动物的睡眠时间都一样。
quizQuestions.audio: People in different cultures may see the same animal in very different ways.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音,选出与句意相符的一项。
opts: 每个生命都不值得尊重。
每个生命都值得善待和尊重。
quizQuestions.audio: Every creature deserves kindness and respect.

listeningQuestions.audio: Many wild animals are now endangered because of illegal hunting.
opts: 许多野生动物因非法狩猎而濒临灭绝。
许多动物因为太冷而生病。
许多动物在动物园里很开心。
许多人喜欢去野外打猎。

listeningQuestions.audio: Good zoos focus on the health and welfare of their animals.
opts: 好的动物园只在乎赚钱。
好的动物园专注于动物的健康与福利。
好的动物园从不喂动物。
好的动物园只养一种动物。

listeningQuestions.audio: The old man fed the penguin a daily diet of fish to get its strength up.
opts: 老人把企鹅放回了大海。
老人每天喂企鹅鱼,好让它恢复体力。

listeningQuestions.audio: Some bears go into a deep sleep called hibernation in winter.
opts: 有些熊整个冬天都醒着。
有些熊冬天会去更暖的地方。
有些熊冬天不吃东西就死了。
有些熊冬天会进入一种叫冬眠的深睡。

listeningQuestions.audio: Training a guide dog needs a lot of patience and a gentle approach.
opts: 训练导盲犬需要很多耐心和温和的方式。
训练导盲犬靠大声吓唬。
训练导盲犬只要一天就够了。
训练导盲犬不需要任何耐心。

listeningQuestions.audio: If you find a hurt wild animal, call a rescue centre rather than touch it.
opts: 如果发现受伤的野生动物,把它带回家。
如果发现受伤的野生动物,打给救助中心而不要触碰它。
如果发现受伤的野生动物,直接忽略它。
如果发现受伤的野生动物,马上抱起它。

finalReading.passage: A young elephant once fell into a deep mud pit and could not climb out on its own. Workers from a nearby rescue centre spent the whole afternoon gently digging away the mud and pulling it free. By evening the tired but healthy elephant walked back to its herd, and the rescuers felt proud that their patient effort had saved a life.

questions.q: Why could the young elephant not get out of the pit?
options: It had sunk deep into the mud and was unable to get out by itself.
It was too lazy to move.
It was tied to a tree.
It was asleep in the pit.
questions.explanation: 原文 'fell into a deep mud pit and could not climb out on its own' 的转述;其余与原文不符。

questions.q: How did the rescuers feel by the end of the day?
options: Angry that they had wasted time.
Proud that their patient work had rescued the young animal.
Sorry they had started the rescue.
Bored with the whole task.
questions.explanation: 末句 'felt proud that their patient effort had saved a life'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Food
units.grammarTitle: -ing/-ed 形式1(作定语 attributives)

writing.prompt: Suppose you are Li Hua. Your Students' Union is preparing a brochure to help visiting foreign students deal with culture shock in China. Write a short article (about 90 words) for the 'Foods and Dining Customs' section, including: 1) a brief introduction to one Chinese food or dining custom (e.g. sharing dishes, using chopsticks, not finishing your bowl); 2) one example that might cause culture shock; 3) a cross-cultural comparison with a simple explanation.
writing.promptCn: 假设你是李华,你校学生会正在为来访的外国学生编写《在中国如何应对文化冲击》手册的《饮食与就餐习俗》栏目。请用英语写一篇约90词的短文,内容包括:① 简要介绍一项中国的食物或就餐习俗(如:共享菜肴、用筷子、不吃光碗里的饭);② 举一个可能让外国人感到文化冲击的例子;③ 做跨文化比较并简单解释原因。注意:用 -ing/-ed 作定语的表达,行文连贯。

finalReading.passage: When Ben joined his Chinese classmates for lunch, he was surprised to see everyone sharing the dishes in the middle of the table. At first he felt unsure, but his friends kindly showed him how to take a little from each plate with his own chopsticks. By the end of the meal, he felt relaxed and grateful, and he realised that sharing food was also a warm way of sharing friendship.

questions.q: What surprised Ben at lunch?
options: Everyone took food from shared plates at the centre.
There was no food at all.
Each person ate in a different room.
The classmates spoke only English.
questions.explanation: 原文 'everyone sharing the dishes in the middle of the table' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Ben feel by the end of the meal?
options: Relaxed and grateful.
Angry and tired.
Bored and lonely.
Hungry and upset.
questions.explanation: 末句 'he felt relaxed and grateful'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Sports

lines.text: What a game! I almost screamed when we scored in the last minute.
lines.cn: 多精彩的比赛!最后一分钟进球时我差点叫出来。

lines.text: Me too. Encouraged by the crowd, the players never gave up.
lines.cn: 我也是。在观众的鼓励下,球员们从未放弃。

lines.text: The goalkeeper was amazing. He must have trained really hard.
lines.cn: 门将太棒了,他一定训练得非常刻苦。

lines.text: Definitely. Let's come back next week and support them again.
lines.cn: 当然。我们下周再来,继续支持他们吧。

units.grammarTitle: -ing/-ed 形式2(作状语 adverbials)

reading.passage: In team sports, a single goal is often the result of many small actions: one player wins the ball, another passes it, and a third runs into space to score. Good teammates also support each other when things go wrong, encouraging a player who misses instead of shouting at him. That is why a team playing as one can beat a group of talented players who think only about themselves.
reading.passageCn: 在团队运动中,一个进球往往是许多小动作的结果:一名球员抢到球,另一名传球,第三名插入空当射门。优秀的队友在出问题时也会互相支持,鼓励失误的球员而不是责骂他。这就是为什么一支齐心协力的球队能击败一群只想着自己的天才球员。

questions.q: How is a goal often scored in team sport?
opts: By one player doing everything alone.

questions.q: What do good teammates do when someone misses?
What is the main point?

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about a sport you love. Use chronological order and at least one -ing or -ed adverbial (such as 'Training hard, I ...' or 'Encouraged by my coach, I ...').
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话写一项你喜爱的运动:按时间顺序展开,并至少用一个 -ing 或 -ed 作状语(如 'Training hard, I …' 或 'Encouraged by my coach, I …')。

quizQuestions.q: Winning the title was the ultimate ____ of every player on the team.
When the final whistle blew, the players felt great ____.
The ball hit the crossbar and ____ away into the crowd.
He scored the winning ____ in the last minute of the game.
____ fast down the wing, he passed the ball into the net.
____ by the cheering fans, the players kept fighting to the end.
____ deep breaths, the player tried to calm herself down.
____ from the high stand, the green pitch looked perfect.
听句子选中文:
opts: 他在最后一分钟攻入了制胜进球。
quizQuestions.audio: He scored the winning goal in the last minute of the game.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 体育场里一声巨大的轰鸣告诉她进球了。
quizQuestions.audio: A loud roar around the stadium told her that the goal had gone in.

listeningQuestions.audio: Millions of fans watched the final match on television.
opts: 数百万球迷在电视上观看了那场决赛。
球场上一个观众也没有。

listeningQuestions.audio: Encouraged by the coach, the players kept fighting to the end.
opts: 球员们提前离开了球场。
在教练的鼓励下,球员们坚持拼到最后。

listeningQuestions.audio: The match ended in a draw, so they went to penalties.
opts: 比赛打成平局,于是进入点球。

listeningQuestions.audio: Having trained hard all winter, the team was ready for the season.
opts: 整个冬天刻苦训练后,球队为赛季做好了准备。

listeningQuestions.audio: She took a deep breath before stepping up to take the penalty.
opts: 主罚点球前,她深吸了一口气。

listeningQuestions.audio: Thousands of spectators came to support their home team.
opts: 成千上万的观众前来支持主队。

finalReading.passage: Hana had always been the slowest runner in her class, and other children often laughed at her. Instead of giving up, she got up early every morning to train, encouraged by her older brother. A year later, she surprised everyone by winning the school race, proud of how far her quiet effort had taken her.

questions.q: What did Hana do instead of giving up?
options: She trained early every morning with her brother's support.
She stopped running completely.
She laughed at the other children.
She changed to a different school.

units.title: Road to Success

lines.text: Do you think a person is successful only if they are rich?

lines.cn: 对。幸福的生活比金钱更重要。

lines.text: How do you keep going when a goal feels too hard?
lines.cn: 当目标太难时,你怎么坚持下去?

lines.cn: 我每天迈一小步,而不是放弃。

lines.text: Does that really work?
lines.cn: 那真的有用吗?

lines.cn: 有用。一点一点,这些步子终会汇成成功。

units.grammarTitle: -ing/-ed 形式3(作补语 complements)

金钱是唯一重要的东西。

成功就是变得又富又有名。

listeningQuestions.audio: A person with grit keeps working towards a goal for years.

有毅力的人从不设目标。

listeningQuestions.audio: Almost every great achievement comes after many failures.
opts: 伟大成就从不需要失败。
伟大成就靠一次轻松完成。
几乎每项伟大成就都来自多次失败。
伟大成就只属于幸运儿。

finalReading.passage: When Leo first joined the swimming team, he was the slowest of all and often wanted to quit. He stopped swimming altogether.

questions.q: How did Leo feel a year later?

Proud that his daily effort had paid off.

units.title: Art and Artists

lines.text: I really want to visit the new art museum this Saturday.

units.grammarTitle: 不定式1(作宾语/补语/状语/定语)

units.title: Healthy Lifestyle

lines.text: Should we just get pizza and soda for lunch?
lines.cn: 我们午饭就吃披萨喝汽水好吗?

lines.text: Let's try something healthier. I'm taking charge of my diet.
lines.cn: 试试更健康的吧。我正在掌管自己的饮食。

lines.text: But I really want a soda.
lines.cn: 可我真的很想喝汽水。

lines.text: Sugary drinks just add extra calories. Why not have water?
lines.cn: 含糖饮料只是增加多余热量,何不喝水呢?

lines.text: I'm always tired and have no energy after class.
lines.cn: 我下课后总是很累,没有精力。

lines.text: Try exercising. It builds energy instead of using it up.
lines.cn: 试试运动吧,它能增加而非消耗精力。

lines.text: But I'm too tired to start.
lines.cn: 可我太累了,不想开始。

lines.cn: 那就和我一起慢跑吧,有朋友更有趣。

units.grammarTitle: 省略(Ellipsis)

reading.passage: When you feel tired, a morning workout is often better than an extra hour of sleep. A single session of exercise can lower your stress, improve your heart health and even leave you with more energy. Working out does not use up your energy; it builds it.
reading.passageCn: 当你感到疲惫时,晨练往往比多睡一小时更好。一次锻炼就能减轻压力、改善心脏健康,甚至让你更有精力。锻炼不会耗尽精力,反而会增加精力。

questions.q: What is often better than an extra hour of sleep?
What does the passage say a workout does to your energy?
opts: It quickly uses it all up.
It builds it rather than using it up.
It has no effect on it.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。

listeningQuestions.audio: Sugary drinks just add extra calories with little benefit.

listeningQuestions.audio: Exercise builds energy rather than using it up.

Bored with all his new habits.
Sorry that he had started at all.

units.title: Life and Technology

dialogues.title: Should I Buy a Robot Dog?

units.title: Learning for Life

listeningQuestions.audio: Curie learned a love of poetry from her father.
opts: 居里从父亲那里学会了热爱诗歌。

listeningQuestions.audio: John Goodenough won the Nobel Prize at the age of ninety-seven.
opts: 古德纳夫很年轻就得奖了。
古德纳夫从未上过大学。
古德纳夫九十七岁时获得了诺贝尔奖。

listeningQuestions.audio: Xunzi said that learning should never cease.
opts: 荀子认为学习应尽早停止。

listeningQuestions.audio: We often understand an idea best after we try it ourselves.
opts: 亲手尝试后,我们往往最能理解一个想法。
我们只能从书本里学东西。
理解一个想法不需要努力。

listeningQuestions.audio: This time tomorrow, the volunteers will be helping the children read.
opts: 志愿者昨天帮过孩子们。
明天这个时候,志愿者们将正在帮孩子们读书。
孩子们正在帮助志愿者。

finalReading.passage: When Mr Lin retired at sixty, he decided to study painting, something he had never tried before. Although his early pictures looked clumsy, he kept practising every single day and asked younger artists for help. Three years later, his works were shown in a small local gallery, and he felt proud that a late start had not stopped him at all.

questions.q: Why was painting a new challenge for Mr Lin?
options: He had never tried it before retiring.
He had painted all his life.
He disliked all kinds of art.
He was forced to learn it at work.
questions.explanation: 原文 'something he had never tried before' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Mr Lin feel three years later?
options: Sorry that he had ever begun.
Proud that beginning so late had still led to success.
Bored with painting completely.
Afraid to show his works to anyone.
questions.explanation: 末句 'felt proud that a late start had not stopped him' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Volunteering

lines.text: I want to start volunteering, but I don't know where to begin.
lines.cn: 我想做志愿者,可不知从哪儿开始。

lines.text: Think about what you really care about first.
lines.cn: 先想想你真正在意什么。

lines.text: I love animals, so maybe I'll help at the shelter.
lines.cn: 我喜欢动物,也许我会去收容所帮忙。

lines.text: Great. I'll ask whether they need helpers this weekend.
lines.cn: 太好了。我去问问他们这周末是否需要帮手。

lines.text: How was your visit to the care home today?
lines.cn: 你今天去敬老院怎么样?

lines.text: Lovely. An old man told me how he had been a teacher for forty years.
lines.cn: 很愉快。一位老人给我讲他当了四十年老师。

lines.text: Did he enjoy it?
lines.cn: 他喜欢这次探访吗?

lines.text: Yes, he asked whether I could come back next week.
lines.cn: 喜欢,他问我下周能不能再来。

units.grammarTitle: 宾语从句(复习)

reading.passage: Every year on the fifth of December, millions of people around the world celebrate International Volunteer Day. Some clean up parks, others donate blood or visit the elderly, and many simply help neighbours they have never met. These small actions remind us that anyone can make a difference.
reading.passageCn: 每年12月5日,世界各地数百万人庆祝国际志愿者日。有人清理公园,有人献血或探望老人,还有许多人只是帮助素未谋面的邻居。这些小小的行动提醒我们:人人都能带来改变。

questions.q: When do people celebrate International Volunteer Day?
What do these small actions remind us of?
opts: That anyone can make a difference.

writing.prompt: Write a short essay (about 60 words) for the column "Voices of Volunteers." Give one statement about why volunteering matters, and use an object clause such as "I believe that …".
writing.promptCn: 为 'Voices of Volunteers' 专栏写一篇约60词的短文,给出一个关于志愿服务为何重要的观点,并至少用一个宾语从句(如 I believe that …)。

quizQuestions.q: Many groups have ____ to be listed on the volunteer website.
Volunteers ____ food and clothes to the homeless shelter every winter.
His team is ____ local restaurants to sell more paper bottles.
Even a small action can ____ a real difference in your community.
I really hope ____ more students will join our recycling campaign.
The interviewer asked Xu Yuan ____ she had any experience before.
Jiang was told ____ she would work during the import expo.
She finally understood ____ her mother had encouraged her to volunteer.
听句子选中文:
opts: 志愿服务能培养更积极的人生态度并有益健康。
志愿服务总是又累又无聊。
quizQuestions.audio: Volunteering can develop a positive attitude towards life and is good for your health.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 这个夏令营不再需要任何人。
选你喜欢的志愿工作,它就不会像苦差事。
所有志愿者都得到很高的工资。
孩子们拒绝参加任何游戏。
quizQuestions.audio: Choose volunteer work you enjoy, and it won't feel like a chore.

listeningQuestions.audio: Joris raised money to purchase GPS collars that protect the cheetahs.
opts: 乔里斯筹钱购买保护猎豹的GPS颈圈。
乔里斯卖掉了他的宠物猫。
乔里斯害怕所有的野生动物。
乔里斯在动物园里工作。

listeningQuestions.audio: The twins launched a website that connects children with volunteer work.
opts: 双胞胎关闭了他们的网站。
双胞胎创建了一个把孩子和志愿工作联系起来的网站。
双胞胎拒绝帮助任何人。

listeningQuestions.audio: Jackson is leading a campaign to promote reusable water bottles in his town.
opts: 杰克逊搬到了另一个城市。
杰克逊正发起一场推广可重复使用水瓶的运动。
杰克逊放弃了他的环保俱乐部。

listeningQuestions.audio: She asked me whether I had ever done any volunteer work before.
opts: 她告诉我她不需要帮助。
她问我以前有没有做过志愿工作。

listeningQuestions.audio: Pippa learned that you should do careful research before helping a community.
opts: 皮帕懂得了帮助社区前应先做仔细的调查。
皮帕决定再也不旅行了。
皮帕在坦桑尼亚买了很多礼物。

listeningQuestions.audio: On the fifth of December, people around the world celebrate International Volunteer Day.
opts: 人们在元旦庆祝国际志愿者日。
在12月5日,世界各地的人庆祝国际志愿者日。
国际志愿者日每两年才有一次。
只有老师才能庆祝这个节日。

finalReading.passage: When Leo first joined the city clean-up team, he thought one person could never change a whole neighbourhood. Yet he kept turning up every Saturday, picking up litter and planting flowers along the streets. A year later, his neighbours had joined him too, and the once-dirty park had become the pride of the area.

questions.q: What did Leo think when he first joined the team?
options: That one person could not change the neighbourhood.
That the work would be easy and quick.
That nobody else would ever help him.
That the park was already beautiful.
questions.explanation: 原文开头他觉得一个人改变不了整个社区的转述;其余选项与原文不符或未提。

questions.q: What had happened a year later?
options: Leo gave up and left the team.
Neighbours joined him and the park improved greatly.
The park became dirtier than before.
The city closed the clean-up team.
questions.explanation: 末句邻居加入、公园变成骄傲的转述(覆盖短文后半段)。

units.title: Adventuring

lines.text: I just read about Shackleton. What an amazing explorer!
lines.cn: 我刚读了沙克尔顿的故事,真是了不起的探险家!

lines.text: Didn't his ship get crushed by the ice?
lines.cn: 他的船不是被冰压碎了吗?

lines.text: Yes, but he still brought every man home alive.
lines.cn: 是的,但他仍把每个人都活着带回了家。

lines.text: That's true courage. I'd like to read about him too.
lines.cn: 那才是真正的勇气。我也想读读他的故事。

lines.text: I'd love to join a polar expedition one day.
lines.cn: 我真想有朝一日参加一次极地探险。

lines.text: It takes a lot of planning. You can't just set out.
lines.cn: 那需要大量准备,不能贸然出发。

lines.text: What should I learn first?
lines.cn: 我该先学什么?

lines.text: Learn to read maps and watch the weather, and always carry a radio.
lines.cn: 学会看地图、留意天气,并随身带无线电。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 被动语态(过去完成被动·过去进行被动)

units.grammarTitle: 被动语态(过去完成被动·过去进行被动)

reading.passage: Shackleton's most famous journey was, in a way, a failure: his ship was lost in the ice and he never reached the land he set out to cross. Yet he is remembered as a hero, because his calm leadership brought every member of the crew home alive.
reading.passageCn: 从某种意义上说,沙克尔顿最著名的旅程是一次失败:他的船在冰中失踪,他始终没能到达想要横穿的陆地。然而他被铭记为英雄,因为他沉着的领导力把全体船员都活着带回了家。

questions.q: Why is the journey called a failure?
opts: His ship was lost and he never reached his goal.
All his men died on the ice.
He gave up after one day.
He refused to lead the crew.

questions.q: Why is Shackleton remembered as a hero?
opts: His leadership brought everyone home alive.
He found gold on the ice.

writing.prompt: Write about 60 words on an explorer or adventure you admire: who or what it is, one thing that makes the story amazing, and why you find it inspiring.
writing.promptCn: 用约60词写一位你敬佩的探险者或一次冒险:是谁/是什么、故事中最了不起的一点,以及它为何打动你。

quizQuestions.q: 探险者、勘探者,用哪个词?
幸存、渡过难关,用哪个词?
卓越的、杰出的,用哪个词?
舍弃、弃(船),用哪个词?
By 1915 the ship ____ completely by the ice.
quizQuestions.point: 过去完成被动 had been done

quizQuestions.q: Great efforts ____ to free the ship when the ice broke.
quizQuestions.point: 过去进行被动 were being done

quizQuestions.q: The route ____ on foot by anyone before that day.
The wounded man ____ by two friends when we got there.
quizQuestions.point: 过去进行被动 was being done

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选意思:
opts: 他们在冰上扎营,缓缓向北漂去。
他们游到了最近的城市。
quizQuestions.audio: They camped on the ice and drifted slowly north.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选意思:
opts: 如果在严寒中睡着,他们可能再也醒不来。
他们随时都能停下来好好睡一觉。
天气太热让他们睡不着。
他们坐着船一直在睡觉。
quizQuestions.audio: If they fell asleep in the cold, they might never wake up.

listeningQuestions.audio: The explorer brought every man home alive after two years on the ice.
opts: 在冰上的两年后,探险者把每个人都活着带回了家。
探险者独自一人逃回了家。
船员们全都留在了岛上。
探险者用了两天就回家了。

listeningQuestions.audio: The ship was crushed by the ice before it finally sank.
opts: 这艘船被冰压碎后最终沉没。
这艘船安全地回到了港口。

listeningQuestions.audio: No one had ever crossed the island on foot before that day.
opts: 在那天之前从没有人徒步穿越过这座岛。
很多人常常徒步穿越这座岛。
他们坐船绕过了这座岛。

listeningQuestions.audio: Great efforts were being made when the storm suddenly hit the boat.
opts: 风暴突然袭来时,人们正在做巨大的努力。
风暴来时大家都在睡觉。

listeningQuestions.audio: Modern explorers can call for rescue by radio if something goes wrong.
opts: 如果出了问题,现代探险者能用无线电求救。
现代探险者从不带任何装备。
现代探险者不会遇到危险。
现代探险者只能徒步回家。

listeningQuestions.audio: Real courage is often shown in how we deal with failure.
opts: 真正的勇气常常体现在我们如何面对失败。
勇敢的人从不感到害怕。
失败的人都不值得记住。

finalReading.passage: When the young explorer's boat became stuck in the ice, most people thought the whole team was lost for good. Instead of panicking, the captain shared out the food fairly and kept everyone busy with daily tasks. Months later, every single member of the crew was rescued alive, and the captain was praised more for his calm leadership than for the distance he had travelled.

questions.q: What did the captain do when the boat became stuck?
options: He shared food fairly and gave everyone daily tasks.
He left the crew and walked away alone.
He panicked and gave up at once.
He kept all the food for himself.
questions.explanation: 原文 shared out the food fairly and kept everyone busy with daily tasks 的转述;其余与原文相反。

questions.q: Why was the captain mainly praised?
options: For the great distance he had covered.
For his calm leadership during the danger.
For finding treasure on the ice.
For sailing faster than anyone else.
questions.explanation: 末句 praised more for his calm leadership than for the distance(短文后半,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Future Living

dialogues.title: What Would You Put in Your Future Home?

lines.text: What would you most like to have in your future home?
lines.cn: 你最想在未来的家里拥有什么?

lines.text: A home computer, which does all the housework for me.
lines.cn: 一台家用电脑,它替我做所有家务。

lines.text: That sounds great. Why that one?
lines.cn: 听起来真棒。为什么选它?

lines.text: Because then I would have far more leisure time.
lines.cn: 因为那样我就能有多得多的闲暇时间。

dialogues.title: A Smart Home or a Simple One?

lines.text: Do you think a smart home is always better?
lines.cn: 你觉得智能家居总是更好吗?

lines.text: It is comfortable, but we should stay in control of the machines.
lines.cn: 它很舒适,但我们应当掌控这些机器。

lines.text: I agree. A home should serve us, not replace us.
lines.cn: 我同意。家应当为我们服务,而不是取代我们。

lines.text: Exactly. Let robots do the chores while we make our own choices.
lines.cn: 正是。让机器人做家务,而我们自己做选择。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 非限制性定语从句(Non-defining relative clauses)

units.grammarTitle: 非限制性定语从句(Non-defining relative clauses)

reading.passage: In the future home, a quiet electronic servant controls the lighting, the temperature and the security. It takes over almost all the housework, which gives the family much more leisure time. Most of the power comes from solar panels, so the home costs very little to run.
reading.passageCn: 在未来的家里,一位安静的电子仆人掌管灯光、温度和安全。它接管了几乎所有家务,这让家人有了多得多的闲暇时间。大部分电力来自太阳能板,所以这个家几乎不花什么钱就能运转。

questions.q: What does the electronic servant control?
Why does the family have more leisure time?
opts: Because the servant does almost all the housework.
Because the power is cut off.

writing.prompt: Describe one piece of future technology you would like in your home. Say what it is, what it does, and how it would make your life better. Try to use a non-defining relative clause (…, which …).
writing.promptCn: 描写一项你想拥有的未来家居科技:它是什么、有什么功能、会如何让你的生活更好(试着用非限制性定语从句 …, which …)。

quizQuestions.q: The home computer will oversee the home's ____.（安全)
You can ____ any electrical appliance to the power wall.（把……附上)
From far away, the grey skyscrapers all look ____.（完全相同的)
My lights turn on ____ each morning to wake me up.（自动地)
The dome house, ____ is energy-saving, needs very little power.
My uncle, ____ lives in a smart house, never does any housework.
The boy, ____ mother had passed away, lived with a robot servant.
Robots took over the housework, ____ gave people more leisure time.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 每个房间都有一面电力墙,而不是插座。
quizQuestions.audio: Each room has a power wall instead of a socket.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 系统会过滤空气并加上香味。
quizQuestions.audio: The system filters the air and then scents it.

listeningQuestions.audio: The home computer will oversee the security of the whole house.
opts: 家用电脑将监管整座房子的安全。
家用电脑会自己打扫房间。

listeningQuestions.audio: Push a button and the walls will move to change the room size.
opts: 按一下按钮,墙壁就会移动来改变房间大小。

listeningQuestions.audio: Most of the power comes from solar panels in the dome roof.
opts: 大部分电力来自穹顶屋顶的太阳能板。

listeningQuestions.audio: Robots now do almost all the housework in the future home.
opts: 人们仍然自己做所有家务。
在未来的家里,机器人几乎包办所有家务。

listeningQuestions.audio: Lina has been the family's reliable housekeeper for many years.
opts: 莉娜多年来一直是这家可靠的管家。
莉娜刚刚离开了这个家。

listeningQuestions.audio: A smart home should serve you, not replace you.
opts: 智能家居应当为你服务,而不是取代你。

finalReading.passage: When Tom first moved into a smart home, he felt strange because the lights, the air and even his breakfast were all managed by a quiet home computer. At first he missed doing little things for himself, yet within a few weeks he was enjoying the extra free time it gave him. Now he uses those calm afternoons to read, paint and visit his friends, things he had never had time for before.

questions.q: Why did Tom feel strange at first in the smart home?
options: Because a home computer managed nearly everything for him.
Because the house had no electricity at all.
Because he could not find his bedroom.
Because the robot kept making mistakes.
questions.explanation: 原文 'the lights, the air and even his breakfast were all managed by a quiet home computer' 的转述;其余未提或与原文相反。

questions.q: How does Tom spend his free time now?
options: Worrying about the machines.
Reading, painting and seeing friends.
Doing all the housework himself.
Trying to leave the smart home.
questions.explanation: 末句 'read, paint and visit his friends'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Scientists

lines.text: Which scientist do you admire most?
lines.cn: 你最敬佩哪位科学家?

lines.text: Marie Curie. Her story is really inspiring.
lines.cn: 居里夫人。她的故事真的很鼓舞人心。

lines.text: Why are you so inspired by her?
lines.cn: 你为什么这么受她鼓舞?

lines.text: Because she never gave up, even when it was hard.
lines.cn: 因为即使再难，她也从不放弃。

lines.text: Did you hear about the ninety-seven-year-old Nobel winner?
lines.cn: 你听说那位九十七岁的诺贝尔奖得主了吗?

lines.text: Yes! It's amazing that he was still working at that age.
lines.cn: 听说了!他那个年纪还在工作，太了不起了。

lines.text: It shows it's never too late to make a contribution.
lines.cn: 这说明做出贡献永远不嫌晚。

lines.text: Exactly. I feel really encouraged by his story.
lines.cn: 正是。我被他的故事深深鼓舞。

units.grammarTitle: -ing/-ed 形式4(作表语 predicatives)

reading.passage: John Goodenough did some of his best work after the age of seventy. He helped invent a battery that now powers phones and cars all over the world. In 2019, at the age of ninety-seven, he became the oldest person ever to win a Nobel Prize, showing that it is never too late to make a great contribution.
reading.passageCn: 约翰·古迪纳夫在七十岁之后完成了他最出色的一些工作。他帮助发明了如今为全世界手机和汽车供电的电池。2019年，九十七岁的他成为获诺贝尔奖年龄最大的人，证明了做出伟大贡献永远不嫌晚。

questions.q: What did Goodenough help to invent?
opts: A battery used in phones and cars.

questions.q: Why is his 2019 prize so remarkable?
opts: He was the oldest person ever to win a Nobel Prize.
He was the youngest winner ever.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph about a scientist you admire. Say who the person is, what they did, and why you admire them. Try to use the unit's -ing/-ed forms as predicatives.
writing.promptCn: 写一小段你敬佩的科学家:他/她是谁、做了什么、你为什么敬佩(试着用本单元的 -ing/-ed 形式作表语，如 inspiring / inspired)。

quizQuestions.q: We ____ this rich seed bank to Zhong Yang.（归功于）
She had an undying ____ for science all her life.（酷爱）
Franklin received almost no ____ for her key discovery.（认可）
Despite all the ____, the team never gave up.（艰难）
The results of the experiment were truly ____.
When the monkeys survived, the scientists were ____.
Her dream job is ____ new planets in deep space.
For many years, the mystery of DNA remained ____.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 他从不后悔成为一名科学家。
quizQuestions.audio: He has never regretted being a scientist.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 好奇心是科学家最重要的品质之一。
quizQuestions.audio: Curiosity is one of the most important qualities of a scientist.

listeningQuestions.audio: Zhong Yang gave his life to collecting seeds in Tibet.
opts: 钟扬一生致力于在西藏采集种子。

listeningQuestions.audio: Franklin's photograph held the key to the shape of DNA.
opts: 富兰克林的照片藏着DNA形状的关键。

listeningQuestions.audio: Hawking kept working for more than fifty years.
opts: 霍金坚持工作了五十多年。

listeningQuestions.audio: Curie won the Nobel Prize in two different fields.
opts: 居里夫人在两个不同领域获得诺贝尔奖。

listeningQuestions.audio: Every great discovery begins with a simple question.
opts: 每个伟大的发现都始于一个简单的问题。

listeningQuestions.audio: The young students were amazed by the model of the human body.
opts: 学生们对模型毫无兴趣。
年轻学生被人体模型深深震撼。

finalReading.passage: As a boy, Thomas Edison was so curious that he once sat on a nest of eggs to see if they would hatch. His many questions often puzzled his teachers, who thought he was a slow learner. But his mother trusted him and taught him at home, turning a restless child into one of the world's greatest inventors.

questions.q: What does the story suggest about Edison as a boy?
options: He was extremely curious about how things worked.
He disliked learning anything new.
He was afraid of asking questions.
He was the best student in his class.
questions.explanation: 原文 'so curious that he once sat on a nest of eggs' 体现他极为好奇的转述;其余与原文相反。

questions.q: How did Edison's mother help him?
options: She sent him away to a famous school.
She believed in him and taught him herself.
She told him to stop asking questions.
She thought he was a slow learner too.
questions.explanation: 原文 'his mother trusted him and taught him at home' 的转述;'slow learner' 是老师的看法,非母亲。

units.title: Language and Mind

lines.text: Did you know Russian has two different words for blue?
lines.cn: 你知道俄语里蓝色有两个不同的词吗?

lines.text: Really? In English we just say 'blue' for everything.
lines.cn: 真的吗?英语里什么都只说'蓝'。

lines.text: That's why Russian speakers spot the two shades a little faster.
lines.cn: 所以俄语者能稍微更快地分辨这两种色度。

lines.text: Amazing. So the words we know really can train our eyes.
lines.cn: 太神奇了。原来我们知道的词真的能训练眼睛。

lines.text: Everyone speaks English now, so why learn anything else?
lines.cn: 现在人人都说英语,为什么还要学别的?

lines.text: Because what a new language offers is a whole new way of thinking.
lines.cn: 因为一门新语言带来的是一种全新的思维方式。

lines.text: I never thought of it like that.
lines.cn: 我从没这么想过。

lines.text: The truth is that every language opens a different window on the world.
lines.cn: 事实是,每种语言都为你打开一扇看世界的不同窗户。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 主语从句 & 表语从句

units.grammarTitle: 主语从句 & 表语从句

reading.passage: In English you say, 'He broke the glass,' even when it was an accident. In Spanish you might simply say, 'The glass broke,' as if no one were to blame. Such small differences may shape how quickly we look for someone to blame.
reading.passageCn: 在英语里,即使是意外,你也会说'他打破了杯子';在西班牙语里,你可能只说'杯子破了',仿佛无人需要负责。这种细小的差别也许会影响我们多快去寻找该责怪的人。

questions.q: How might an English speaker describe the accident?
opts: By naming the person who broke the glass.
By saying the glass broke on its own.

questions.q: What might these small differences shape?
opts: The price of a new glass.
How quickly we look for someone to blame.
The colour of the broken glass.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph about a language you would like to learn. Say which language it is, why you want to learn it, and what you hope it will open up for you. Try to use a subject or predicative clause.
writing.promptCn: 写一小段话,谈一门你想学的语言:是哪门、为什么想学、你希望它为你打开什么。试着用上主语从句或表语从句(如 What I want is… / The truth is that…)。

quizQuestions.q: Bilingual children sometimes ____ their classmates in memory tests.（胜过）
Different languages make us pay ____ to different things.（注意）
Many ____ are working hard to save dying languages.（语言学家）
Small word choices can have a real ____ on our judgement.（影响）

It is widely accepted ____ thought and language influence each other.
The real question is ____ language shapes thought or thought shapes language.
The reason is ____ their language makes them notice such details.

opts: 每种语言都以不同方式划分世界。
语言不影响我们看世界。
quizQuestions.audio: Each language divides the world in its own way.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 拯救一门语言能让一整种看世界的方式存续。
quizQuestions.audio: Saving a language keeps a whole way of seeing the world alive.

listeningQuestions.audio: Language can quietly shape the way we think.
opts: 语言能悄悄塑造我们的思维方式。

listeningQuestions.audio: Russian speakers can tell light and dark blue apart faster.
opts: 俄语者能更快区分浅蓝和深蓝。
俄语里没有蓝色这个词。

listeningQuestions.audio: Speaking two languages gives the brain a healthy workout.
opts: 会说两种语言给大脑做健康的锻炼。

listeningQuestions.audio: Many languages around the world are in danger of dying out.
opts: 世界上所有语言都很安全。
世界上许多语言正面临消亡的危险。

listeningQuestions.audio: Even unborn babies can distinguish between two languages.
opts: 甚至未出生的婴儿也能区分两种语言。
婴儿只能听懂一种语言。
婴儿出生后才会听声音。

listeningQuestions.audio: What a new language offers is a fresh way of seeing the world.
opts: 一门新语言带来的是看世界的全新方式。
学新语言会让人忘记母语。

finalReading.passage: When Mai started learning Japanese, her friends asked why she bothered, since she already spoke English well. She kept going, and within a year she could enjoy Japanese stories that no translation could fully capture. Looking back, she felt that each new language had quietly given her a fresh way of seeing the world.

questions.q: Why did Mai's friends question her choice?
options: They thought knowing English was already enough.
They disliked Japanese food.
They wanted her to study French instead.
They believed she spoke no English.

questions.q: How did Mai feel about language learning later?
options: She regretted wasting her time.
Each language had broadened how she understood the world.
She found the whole effort useless.
She had forgotten all her English.
questions.explanation: 末句'a fresh way of seeing the world'的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Charity

lines.text: Our class wants to do something kind this week.
lines.cn: 我们班这周想做点善事。

lines.text: How about visiting the nursing home?
lines.cn: 去养老院看望老人怎么样?

lines.text: Great idea! The elderly love having visitors.
lines.cn: 好主意!老人们喜欢有人来看望。

lines.text: I'm really looking forward to helping them.
lines.cn: 我很期待去帮助他们。

lines.text: These cakes look delicious! How much are they?
lines.cn: 这些蛋糕看着真好吃!多少钱?

lines.text: Five yuan each. All the money goes to sick children.
lines.cn: 每个五元,所有钱都捐给生病的孩子。

lines.text: Wonderful. I'll take three, please.
lines.cn: 太好了,请给我三个。

lines.text: Thank you for supporting our charity sale!
lines.cn: 谢谢你支持我们的义卖!

units.grammarTitle: 动名词(-ing 作主语/宾语)

reading.passage: During the school's charity week, students collected warm coats for children in cold villages. In just three days, they gathered over two hundred coats. The head teacher said it was the kindest thing the school had ever done.
reading.passageCn: 在学校的慈善周,学生们为寒冷山村的孩子收集保暖外套;短短三天就收集了两百多件;校长说这是学校做过的最善良的事。

questions.q: What did the students collect?
How many coats did they gather?

writing.prompt: Write a short story (about 100 words) about a time you helped someone or did a kind deed.

quizQuestions.q: 'donate' 的中文意思是?
'empathy' 的中文意思是?

'volunteer' 作动词时意思是?

quizQuestions.audio: Giving is better than receiving.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子,选出对应中文。

opts: 许多青少年创办自己的慈善组织。

listeningQuestions.audio: Donating books can help children who have none.
opts: 捐书能帮助没有书的孩子。

listeningQuestions.audio: She enjoys volunteering at the nursing home.
opts: 她喜欢在养老院做志愿者。

listeningQuestions.audio: Thank you for helping with the charity sale.
Helping others makes us feel happy.

listeningQuestions.audio: A small act of kindness can warm a cold day.
opts: 小小的善举能温暖寒冷的一天。

finalReading.passage: Ben noticed that his elderly neighbour struggled to carry her shopping up the stairs every day. Without being asked, he began helping her with the heavy bags each evening after school. The old lady was so touched that she baked him cookies, and the two soon became good friends.

questions.q: Why did Ben start helping his neighbour?
options: He saw that she found it hard to carry her shopping upstairs.
She offered to pay him for the help.
His teacher told him he had to.
He wanted some of her cookies.

questions.q: What was the result of Ben's kindness?
options: She quickly moved away.
The two became good friends.
He was paid a large sum.
Nothing at all changed.

units.title: Disaster Survival

lines.text: The radio says a typhoon is coming tonight.
lines.cn: 收音机说今晚有台风要来。

lines.text: Then let's fill some bottles with water and find the torch.
lines.cn: 那我们装几瓶水,再找出手电筒吧。

lines.text: Good idea. I'll put fresh batteries in the radio too.
lines.cn: 好主意。我再给收音机换上新电池。

lines.text: With everything ready, we have nothing to fear.
lines.cn: 一切都准备好了,我们就没什么可怕的了。

lines.text: The flood has gone down. What can we do to help?
lines.cn: 洪水退了。我们能做点什么帮忙呢?

lines.text: Let's clear the street and check on the old couple next door.
lines.cn: 我们去清理街道,再看看隔壁的老两口。

lines.text: Having lost so much, they will need our help.
lines.cn: 他们损失了那么多,会需要我们帮忙的。

lines.text: Yes. Together we can rebuild faster.
lines.cn: 是的。齐心协力,我们能更快重建。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 复合动名词(被动式/完成式 complex -ing)

units.grammarTitle: 复合动名词(被动式/完成式 complex -ing)

reading.passage: During the big flood, a teacher led all her students up to the roof of the school. They waited there calmly until a rescue boat finally arrived. Thanks to her quick thinking, not a single child was hurt.
reading.passageCn: 在那场大洪水中,一位老师把全体学生带到了学校的屋顶。他们在那里镇定地等待,直到一艘救援船终于到来。多亏她反应迅速,没有一个孩子受伤。

questions.q: Where did the teacher lead her students?
opts: To the roof of the school.

questions.q: Why was no child hurt?
opts: Because of the teacher's quick thinking.
Because the flood was very small.
Because they could all swim well.

writing.prompt: Write a short notice (about 60 words) telling classmates how to stay safe in ONE natural disaster, such as an earthquake, a typhoon or a flood. Say what to do before and during it.
writing.promptCn: 写一则约60词的英文须知,告诉同学如何在某一种自然灾害(如地震、台风或洪水)中保护自己,说明灾前和灾中该怎么做。

quizQuestions.q: We must take ____ to protect people from floods.（措施)
Local ____ were moved to safety before the typhoon.（居民)
Hide in a secure ____ during a strong typhoon.（地下室)
Follow the ____ order and leave for higher ground.（撤离)
The little boy was terrified of ____ under the broken wall.
____ everything in the flood, the family had to start again.
____ what to do, many people panicked during the quake.
The captain was praised for ____ all the passengers before the ship sank.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 地震可能毫无预警地发生。
地震总是提前一周通知。
地震不会造成任何伤害。
quizQuestions.audio: Earthquakes can strike without any warning.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 灾难时要准备好求生包。
只有医生才需要求生包。
quizQuestions.audio: Keep a survival kit ready in case of a disaster.

listeningQuestions.audio: A strong typhoon struck the southern coast last night.
opts: 昨晚一场强台风袭击了南部海岸。

listeningQuestions.audio: When you hear a flood warning, move to higher ground.
opts: 听到洪水警报时,要转移到高处。
听到洪水警报时,留在原地不动。
听到洪水警报时,跳进水里。
听到洪水警报时,先去睡觉。

listeningQuestions.audio: Cover your nose and mouth with a wet cloth in a wildfire.
opts: 野火中用湿布捂住口鼻。
野火中把窗户全部打开。

listeningQuestions.audio: A battery-powered radio works even when the power is off.
opts: 停电时电池收音机仍能工作。
收音机只能在白天使用。
停电时收音机也没用了。
收音机需要插电才能用。

listeningQuestions.audio: Get under a solid table when the ground starts to shake.
opts: 地面开始摇晃时,躲到结实的桌子下。
地面摇晃时立刻跳出窗户。

listeningQuestions.audio: The rescue team pulled three people from the rubble.
opts: 救援队从废墟中救出了三个人。
救援队没有找到任何人。

finalReading.passage: When the typhoon warning came on the radio, the Chen family did not wait. Having packed a survival kit the week before, they quickly moved to a shelter on higher ground. The next morning, their whole street was under water, but every member of the family was safe and dry.

questions.q: Why was the Chen family able to act so quickly?
options: They had prepared a survival kit in advance.
They lived right next to the shelter.
The police carried them out by car.
They had never heard the warning before.
questions.explanation: 原文 'Having packed a survival kit the week before' 的转述;事先备好包,所以行动迅速。

questions.q: What happened to their street the next morning?
options: It was covered with flood water.
It was completely dry and clear.
It was filled with cheering crowds.
It was blocked by fallen trees only.
questions.explanation: 末句 'their whole street was under water' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Fighting Stress

lines.text: You look worried. Is everything okay?
lines.cn: 你看起来很担心,一切还好吗?

lines.text: I'm a bit stressed about my exams next week.
lines.cn: 下周的考试让我有点压力。

lines.text: To have a balanced life really helps. Don't forget to rest.
lines.cn: 拥有平衡的生活真的有帮助,别忘了休息。

lines.text: You're right. I'll try to sleep earlier tonight.
lines.cn: 你说得对,我今晚会试着早点睡。

lines.text: What do you do when you feel panicky?
lines.cn: 你惊慌的时候会怎么做?

lines.text: My favourite way to relax is to breathe slowly and deeply.
lines.cn: 我最喜欢的放松方式是缓慢深呼吸。

lines.text: Does it really work?
lines.cn: 这真的有用吗?

lines.text: Yes. After a few minutes, I always feel much calmer.
lines.cn: 有用,几分钟后我总会平静很多。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 不定式作主语和表语(To have a balanced life is the best way…)

units.grammarTitle: 不定式作主语和表语(To have a balanced life is the best way…)

reading.passage: When David felt stressed before his exams, he started going to bed earlier and taking a short walk every afternoon. These small changes helped him sleep better and worry less, and soon he felt ready to face his tests with a calmer mind.
reading.passageCn: 考试前感到压力时,David 开始早点睡觉,并每天下午散一小段步。这些小小的改变让他睡得更好、担忧更少,很快他就以更平静的心态准备迎接考试了。

questions.q: What two changes did David make?
opts: Going to bed earlier and taking a short walk.
Studying all night and skipping meals.

questions.q: How did David feel after these changes?
opts: Calmer and ready for his tests.
Too sleepy to study at all.

writing.prompt: Write a short note to a friend who feels stressed before exams. Tell them one or two ways to relax. Try to use an infinitive as a subject or predicative (e.g. To have a balanced life is the best way to stay calm).
writing.promptCn: 给一位考前感到压力的朋友写一段短信,告诉他/她一两种放松的方法。试着用不定式作主语或表语(如 To have a balanced life is …)。

quizQuestions.q: Too much ____ can make you feel sick and tired.（压力）

绝不要承认自己有压力。
quizQuestions.audio: It is brave to admit that you feel stressed.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。

quizQuestions.audio: My favourite way to relax is to go for a run.

只有考试才会带来压力。

listeningQuestions.audio: A little stress before a test can actually help you focus.
opts: 考前的一点压力会让你失败。
考前的一点压力其实能帮你集中注意力。
压力在任何时候都有害。

units.title: Cherishing Friendship

options: That winning matters more than friendship.
That genuine friends appear right at your moment of need.
That he should find a new team.
That his friends were too busy for him.
questions.explanation: 末句 'true friends are the ones who show up exactly when you need them most' 的转述(覆盖短文后半段)。

units.title: Exploring the Unknown

lines.text: Why do you think the ancient people built Stonehenge?
lines.cn: 你觉得古人为什么要建巨石阵?

lines.text: Many experts hold the belief that it worked as a kind of calendar.
lines.cn: 许多专家相信它曾起一种日历的作用。

lines.text: How could simple tools move such enormous stones?
lines.cn: 用简单的工具怎么能搬动这么巨大的石头?

lines.text: No one is sure, and that is what makes the mystery so interesting.
lines.cn: 没人确定,而这正是这个谜团如此有趣的地方。

lines.text: Did you hear the news that a new species was found in the rainforest?
lines.cn: 你听说在雨林里发现了一个新物种的消息吗?

lines.text: Really? Is there any solid evidence that it lives nowhere else?
lines.cn: 真的吗?有确凿证据证明它只生活在那里吗?

lines.text: Yes. Scientists used satellite images and then explored the area on foot.
lines.cn: 有。科学家先用卫星图像,然后徒步探索了那片地区。

lines.text: That's amazing. There is still so much unknown about our own planet.
lines.cn: 太了不起了。关于我们自己的星球,仍有那么多未知。

units.grammarTitle: 同位语从句(the belief/fact/idea that…)

reading.passage: People have always looked up at the night sky and wondered what lies among the stars. Today, spacecraft travel millions of miles to study distant planets, sending back pictures that answer some old questions and raise many new ones.
reading.passageCn: 人们一直仰望夜空,好奇繁星之间有什么。如今,航天器飞行数百万英里去研究遥远的行星,传回的照片回答了一些老问题,也带来许多新的问题。

questions.q: What have people always done when looking at the night sky?
opts: Wondered what lies among the stars.

questions.q: What do the pictures from spacecraft do?
opts: Answer some questions and raise new ones.

writing.prompt: Write a short report about a mystery you find interesting. Say what the mystery is, give one theory about it, and explain why it interests you. Try to use appositive clauses such as 'the theory that …'.
writing.promptCn: 写一篇关于你感兴趣的某个谜团的短报道:谜团是什么、关于它的一种理论、你为何感兴趣;试着用 'the theory that …' 这类同位语从句。

quizQuestions.q: The deep ____ is the deepest part of the ocean.（海沟)
There is no solid ____ that aliens built the monument.（证据)
The sharp rocks ____ a serious danger to explorers.（造成)
Humans have always longed to explore the ____.（未知)
The belief ____ the world is round was once new.（从句完整,只说明内容)
Scientists study the question ____ there is water on the moon.（是否)
The evidence ____ they found proved the city was real.（从句缺宾语→定语)
There is no doubt ____ the trench is very deep.（no doubt 后)
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 没人确切知道这些巨石是如何被搬动的。
quizQuestions.audio: No one knows exactly how the huge stones were moved.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 深海底部也能找到生命。
quizQuestions.audio: Life can be found even at the bottom of the deep sea.

listeningQuestions.audio: Stonehenge is one of the most famous ancient monuments in the world.
opts: 巨石阵是世界上最著名的古代遗迹之一。
巨石阵是一座现代博物馆。
巨石阵是用木头建成的。

listeningQuestions.audio: The Mariana Trench is the deepest place in the world's oceans.
opts: 马里亚纳海沟是世界海洋中最深的地方。

listeningQuestions.audio: Some tribes were first discovered through satellite images.
opts: 这些部落住在大城市里。
一些部落最初是通过卫星图像被发现的。

listeningQuestions.audio: The sharp limestone rocks can cut through skin.
opts: 锋利的石灰岩能划破皮肤。

listeningQuestions.audio: No one is sure how the islanders moved the giant statues.
opts: 没人确定岛民是如何搬动巨型石像的。

listeningQuestions.audio: There is still no proof that the lake monster is real.
opts: 人们已证明湖怪是真的。
至今仍没有证据证明那湖怪是真的。
科学家拍到了清晰照片。

finalReading.passage: Last summer, a young scientist named Mei joined a team that explored a newly found cave deep in the mountains. Inside, they discovered strange paintings on the walls that no one could explain, along with the bones of animals that had died there long ago. Mei said the mystery only made her more eager to keep exploring the unknown.

questions.q: What did the team find inside the cave?
options: Strange wall paintings and ancient animal bones.
A modern shopping centre.
A busy city street full of cars.
A wide field of green crops.
questions.explanation: 原文说洞里有无人能解释的奇怪壁画,以及很久前死在那里的动物骨头;其余选项与原文不符。

questions.q: How did the discovery make Mei feel?
options: Bored with science.
Keener to go on exploring the unknown.
Sorry that she had joined the team.
Afraid of every cave.
questions.explanation: 末句说这谜团让她更渴望继续探索未知(覆盖短文后半段)。

units.title: Protecting the Environment

lines.text: Which bin should this plastic bottle go in?
lines.cn: 这个塑料瓶应该扔进哪个垃圾箱?

lines.text: The blue one — it's for things we can recycle.
lines.cn: 蓝色那个——它是放可回收物的。

lines.text: I see. So sorting our waste really helps the Earth?
lines.cn: 明白了。所以给垃圾分类真的对地球有帮助吗?

lines.text: Of course. It is small habits like this that make a big difference.
lines.cn: 当然。正是这样的小习惯才能带来大改变。

lines.text: Why is the Earth getting warmer every year?
lines.cn: 为什么地球每年都在变暖?

lines.text: It is gases like carbon dioxide that trap too much heat.
lines.cn: 正是二氧化碳这类气体困住了过多的热量。

lines.text: So what can ordinary people do about it?
lines.cn: 那普通人能为此做些什么呢?

lines.text: Save energy, use less plastic, and plant more trees.
lines.cn: 节约能源、少用塑料、多种树。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 强调结构(It is/was … that … 强调句)

units.grammarTitle: 强调结构(It is/was … that … 强调句)

reading.passage: On a small island, the people once threw all their rubbish straight into the sea. Then the fish began to disappear and the beaches turned grey with plastic. So the islanders started to sort their waste and clean the shore together. Within a few years, the fish came back, and the island became a model for its neighbours.
reading.passageCn: 在一座小岛上,人们曾把所有垃圾直接扔进海里。后来鱼开始消失,海滩被塑料染成灰色。于是岛民们开始给垃圾分类、一起清理海岸。几年之内,鱼回来了,这座小岛也成了邻近地区的榜样。

questions.q: What problem did the island first have?
opts: People threw all their rubbish into the sea.

questions.q: What happened after the islanders sorted their waste?
opts: The fish came back and the island became a model.

writing.prompt: Write a short proposal to your class about one way to protect the environment. Say what the problem is, what you suggest doing, and why it helps. Try to use an emphatic structure (It is … that …).
writing.promptCn: 给你的班级写一段简短倡议:指出一个环境问题、提出你的建议、说明它为什么有用。试着用一个强调句(It is … that …)。

quizQuestions.q: The factory ____ harmful gases into the air every day.（排放）
Six kinds of sea turtle are already ____ with extinction.（受威胁）
The ocean ____ us with the basic elements of life.（维持）
Buying products with less ____ helps to cut down waste.（包装）
It is carbon dioxide ____ the plants need in order to make food.
It was in 1958 ____ the carbon dioxide in the air was first measured.
It is the volunteers ____ clean this beach every weekend.
It was not until the ice began to melt ____ people saw the danger.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 正是我们大家才能拯救地球。
quizQuestions.audio: It is all of us who can save the Earth.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 塑料垃圾会毒害吞食它的海洋动物。
quizQuestions.audio: Plastic waste may poison the sea animals that swallow it.

listeningQuestions.audio: It is carbon dioxide that plants need to produce their food.
opts: 植物正是需要二氧化碳来制造食物。

listeningQuestions.audio: The polar ice caps have begun to melt because of global warming.
opts: 由于全球变暖,极地冰盖已开始融化。

listeningQuestions.audio: Most marine waste is plastic from bottles and packaging.
opts: 大多数海洋垃圾是来自瓶子和包装的塑料。

listeningQuestions.audio: If everyone reduces waste, one day the beaches may stay clean.
opts: 只有专家才能清理海滩。
如果人人减少垃圾,有一天海滩也许能保持干净。

listeningQuestions.audio: It was a young environmentalist who started the rainforest project.
opts: 正是一位年轻的环保人士发起了这个雨林项目。
项目是政府独自完成的。

listeningQuestions.audio: Taking public transport helps to make your carbon footprint smaller.
opts: 乘坐公共交通有助于减小你的碳足迹。

finalReading.passage: When Anna's small town began sorting its rubbish, many people thought it was too much trouble. A year later, the streets were cleaner, far less waste was buried in the ground, and even the children knew which bin to use. Today the town is proud to be one of the greenest places in the whole area.

questions.q: How did many people feel about sorting rubbish at first?
options: They felt it would be a bother.
They were excited to start at once.
They wanted to sell their rubbish.
They refused to use any bins.
questions.explanation: 对应 'many people thought it was too much trouble' 的转述;其余与原文不符或未提。

questions.q: What was the town like one year later?
options: Dirtier and full of waste.
Exactly the same as before.
Cleaner, with much less waste buried.
Empty because people had left.
questions.explanation: 对应 'the streets were cleaner, far less waste was buried in the ground' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Achieving Effective Communication

lines.text: The contest is on Friday and I'm terrified.
lines.cn: 比赛在周五,我好害怕。

lines.text: Practise out loud until the words feel natural.
lines.cn: 大声练习,直到说得自然。

lines.text: I always rush when I'm nervous.
lines.cn: 我一紧张就语速太快。

lines.text: Breathe slowly first, then speak to one friendly face.
lines.cn: 先慢慢呼吸,再对着一张友善的脸说。

lines.text: Your opening question made us all curious.
lines.cn: 你开场的提问让我们都很好奇。

lines.text: Thanks. But I read too much from my notes.
lines.cn: 谢谢,但我太多照稿念了。

lines.text: Next time, use a card with only key words.
lines.cn: 下次用只写关键词的卡片。

lines.text: And look up at the audience more. I'll try.
lines.cn: 还要多抬头看观众。我会试试。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 复杂句综合(定语/状语/名词性从句的句法分析与运用)

units.grammarTitle: 复杂句综合(定语/状语/名词性从句的句法分析与运用)

reading.passage: When Mia stepped onto the stage, her hands were shaking. She found one friendly face in the crowd, took a slow breath, and began to speak to that single person. Little by little, the whole room felt smaller, and her fear melted away.
reading.passageCn: 米娅走上舞台时双手发抖。她在人群中找到一张友善的脸,缓缓吸了口气,然后对着那一个人开始讲。渐渐地,整个房间似乎变小了,她的恐惧也消散了。

questions.q: What did Mia do to calm herself?
opts: She spoke to one friendly face and breathed slowly
She closed her eyes and shouted
She read quickly from a script

questions.q: What happened to Mia's fear by the end?

writing.prompt: Write a short summary (about 50 words) of a talk on how to keep an audience engaged.
writing.promptCn: 用约50词写一篇关于“如何让听众保持专注”的演讲摘要:先用一句话概括总观点,再提炼三到四条建议,用自己的话表达。

quizQuestions.q: 选出与 deliver a speech 意思最接近的表达。
communication barrier 指的是什么?
be passionate about sth 最贴切的意思是?
reach a compromise 的意思是?
The lecturer ____ overcame his fear later became famous.
____ you keep practising, you will gradually beat stage fright.
____ matters most in a great speech is a genuine connection with people.
The fact ____ a deaf-blind girl could learn to read amazed the world.
听句子选中文:
opts: 走动和提问有助于吸引听众参与。
quizQuestions.audio: Movement and questions help engage the listeners.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 眼神交流让听众觉得你在和他们说话。
演讲时应避免目光接触。
quizQuestions.audio: Eye contact makes listeners feel you are talking to them.

listeningQuestions.audio: A good speaker keeps the audience interested from start to finish.
opts: 好的演讲者能让听众从头到尾都感兴趣。
好的演讲者总是说得很快。
好的演讲者从不看观众。

listeningQuestions.audio: Practising aloud again and again helps you sound natural on stage.
opts: 反复大声练习能让你在台上显得自然。
上台前不要做任何准备。

listeningQuestions.audio: If you feel nervous inside, you can still look confident on stage.
opts: 即使内心紧张,你仍能在台上显得自信。

listeningQuestions.audio: Braille lets blind people read and write by touching raised dots.
opts: 盲文让盲人通过触摸凸点来读写。

listeningQuestions.audio: A sincere respect for differences helps us cross the cultural barrier.
opts: 真诚尊重差异有助于我们跨越文化障碍。
说得更大声能解决文化障碍。
文化障碍是无法克服的。

listeningQuestions.audio: A good summary catches the main point and leaves out small examples.
opts: 好的摘要抓住主旨、略去小例子。
好的摘要要照抄原文长句。

finalReading.passage: Before his first online interview, Daniel arranged his camera so that the light fell on his face rather than behind him. He looked straight into the lens, spoke a little more slowly than usual, and paused now and then to let his answers settle. By the end, the manager said he had seemed remarkably calm and clear, even through a small screen.

questions.q: Why did Daniel make the light fall on his face?
options: To avoid appearing as a dark shape on screen
To make the room feel warmer
To save electricity during the call
To hide his nervous expression
questions.explanation: 把光打在脸上是为了不显得像屏幕上的暗影,选项是对原文意图的转述。

questions.q: What did Daniel do while answering questions?
options: He shouted to be heard clearly
He paused at times so his words could sink in
He read every answer from a script
He looked away from the camera
questions.explanation: 他不时停顿,让回答被听者消化吸收。

questions.q: How did the manager describe Daniel at the end?
options: Confused and unprepared
Loud but unclear
Calm and easy to follow
Bored and distant
questions.explanation: 经理说他显得十分镇定清晰,'calm and clear' 的转述。

units.title: Learning about Trade and Economy

lines.text: How much is this silk scarf?
lines.cn: 这条丝巾多少钱？

lines.text: It's two hundred yuan, but business is slow, so I can offer one hundred and seventy.
lines.cn: 二百元，不过今天生意清淡，我可以一百七卖给你。

lines.text: How about one hundred and sixty, and I'll take two?
lines.cn: 一百六怎么样，我买两条？

lines.text: All right, it's a deal.
lines.cn: 好的，成交。

lines.text: My old phone still works, but I really want the new model.
lines.cn: 我的旧手机还能用，但我很想要新款。

lines.text: Is the new one really worth a thousand yuan more?
lines.cn: 新款真的值得多花一千元吗？

lines.text: When you put it that way, maybe the extra features aren't worth the extra cost.
lines.cn: 这么一想，额外的功能也许不值额外的花费。

lines.text: That's smart thinking. Save the money for your trip.
lines.cn: 想得很明智，把钱留着去旅行吧。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: -ing/-ed 形式与不定式综合运用(非谓语动词复习)

units.grammarTitle: -ing/-ed 形式与不定式综合运用(非谓语动词复习)

reading.passage: Since China joined the WTO, it has bought more goods from abroad and sold more products to the world. Its rising demand for imports gives trading partners new chances to earn money, while its exports bring cheap, good products to families everywhere.
reading.passageCn: 自加入世贸组织以来，中国从国外购买了更多商品，也向世界卖出了更多产品。其不断上升的进口需求给贸易伙伴带来赚钱的新机会，而其出口则把价廉物美的产品带给各地家庭。

questions.q: How do China's imports help its trading partners?
opts: They give partners new chances to earn money.
They force partners to stop trading.
They make all goods more expensive.

questions.q: What do China's exports bring to families everywhere?

writing.prompt: Write a short summary (about 50 words) of the idea 'Rational people think at the margin', explaining how to weigh the extra benefit and the extra cost of one more step.
writing.promptCn: 用约50词写一段摘要，概括'理性的人会进行边际思考'这一观点，说明如何权衡多走一步的额外收益与额外成本。

quizQuestions.q: 经济迅速增长，创造了更多就业。A strong ____ creates more jobs.
这些产品主要为出口而生产。These products are made for ____.
出口在该国总量中占很大份额。Exports ____ a large share of the total.
价格上涨时买家往往选更便宜的货。Buyers often ____ for cheaper goods.
The factory finished ____ the trade agreement yesterday.
quizQuestions.point: 语法 动名词作宾语

quizQuestions.q: The young company decided ____ the overseas market.
quizQuestions.point: 语法 不定式作宾语

quizQuestions.q: The cheap goods ____ from other countries sold quickly.
quizQuestions.point: 语法 -ed 分词作定语(被动)

quizQuestions.q: The car was too expensive ____ quickly.
听录音，选出与句意相符的一项。
opts: 卖家因今天生意清淡而降价。
卖家因为商品很贵而降价。
买家拒绝购买任何东西。
卖家把价格提高了一倍。
quizQuestions.audio: Because business is slow today, the seller can offer a lower price.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音，选出与句意相符的一项。
opts: 一枚硬币能帮助许多人谋生。
钱总是停在一个地方不动。
quizQuestions.audio: In this way, a single coin can help many different people earn a living.

listeningQuestions.audio: China's foreign trade has grown quickly in recent years.
opts: 近年来中国的对外贸易增长迅速。
中国的贸易每年都在下降。
中国从不和别国做生意。

listeningQuestions.audio: Foreign trade has helped lift millions of people out of poverty.
opts: 对外贸易帮助数百万人摆脱了贫困。
对外贸易让更多人变穷了。
贸易让人们离开了国家。

listeningQuestions.audio: Every choice we make has a hidden opportunity cost.
opts: 我们做的每个选择都有隐藏的机会成本。
我们的选择从来没有成本。

listeningQuestions.audio: Cross-border e-commerce is growing very fast in China.
opts: 跨境电子商务在中国发展得非常快。
电子商务只在国外存在。

listeningQuestions.audio: A wise buyer compares the costs and benefits before paying.
opts: 明智的买家付款前会权衡成本与收益。
明智的买家从不看价格。
买家总是先付钱再考虑。
买东西不需要任何思考。

listeningQuestions.audio: Money works only because people are willing to accept it.
opts: 钱之所以有用,是因为人们愿意接受它。
钱的价值在于它的材料。
贝壳至今仍是主要货币。
硬币对所有人都没有价值。

finalReading.passage: When David had only one free hour, he chose to read for a job exam instead of watching a film. He knew the film would be fun, but the new skills from reading would help him earn more in the future. For David, the hour spent reading was worth far more than the hour he gave up at the cinema.

questions.q: Why did David choose to read rather than watch a film?
options: He believed reading would bring greater gains later.
He disliked every kind of film.
He had no free time at all that day.
He simply wanted to waste the hour.
questions.explanation: 原文'new skills from reading would help him earn more in the future'的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What does David's decision show about how he valued the hour?
options: He saw reading as the more worthwhile use of it.
He thought the film was clearly more useful.
He felt he had nothing at all to give up.
He believed both choices were equally useless.
questions.explanation: 末句'worth far more than the hour he gave up at the cinema'的转述(覆盖短文后半段)。

units.title: Delving into History

lines.text: Have you ever been to the Grand Canal?
lines.cn: 你去过大运河吗?

lines.text: Not yet, but I’d love to take a boat ride there.
lines.cn: 还没,不过我很想去那里坐船游览。

lines.text: Did you know it once carried grain all the way to the north?
lines.cn: 你知道它曾经把粮食一路运到北方吗?

lines.text: Yes, and old trading towns still stand beside it today.
lines.cn: 知道,而且今天运河边还保留着古老的贸易小镇。

stages.title: 语法专项
stages.subtitle: 倒装句(Never before had…; Not only… but also…; 部分/完全倒装)

units.grammarTitle: 倒装句(Never before had…; Not only… but also…; 部分/完全倒装)

reading.passage: The Grand Canal once carried grain, salt and cotton between the south and the north of China. For hundreds of years it was the busy lifeline of the empire, and port cities along it grew rich.
reading.passageCn: 大运河曾在中国南北之间运送粮食、盐和棉布。数百年间它是帝国繁忙的命脉,沿线的港口城市因此富裕起来。

questions.q: What did the Grand Canal carry between south and north?
How did port cities along the canal change?

writing.prompt: In about 60 words, write a short summary of why the Grand Canal mattered to China.
writing.promptCn: 用约60词写一段简短摘要,概括大运河对中国的重要意义。

quizQuestions.q: The Grand Canal became the economic ____ of the empire, on which countless lives depended.
Silk was the most valuable ____ traded from China to the West.
Zhang Qian's missions ____ the way for later trade along the Silk Road.
The project will ____ water from the south to the arid regions of the north.
Not until the railway was built ____ the Grand Canal lose its importance.
Only then ____ how important the canal had been to the empire.
____ the engineers known the danger, they would have changed the route.
So important ____ to trade that emperors kept it in good repair.
Listen and choose the correct meaning.

The Forbidden City was built last year.
The Forbidden City is a modern museum.
The Forbidden City was never finished.

opts: Coastal cities grew rich from sea trade.

丝绸之路连接中国和印度。

listeningQuestions.audio: Silk was the most important good traded along the Silk Road.

盐是运河上唯一的货物。

历史让我们忘记一切往事。

opts: 在古迹绝不要触碰古老的墙壁或文物。

参观前不必了解任何历史。

finalReading.passage: The terracotta dancers and musicians once travelled along the Silk Road, bringing music and dance from Central Asia into China. People in ancient cities crowded the streets to watch these colourful performances. Even today, old paintings and pottery show us how popular such shows once were.

questions.q: What did the terracotta dancers and musicians bring into China?
options: Performing arts from the lands to China’s west.
New kinds of food and drink.
Heavy goods such as iron and salt.
Books written in classical Greek.
questions.explanation: 原文 “bringing music and dance from Central Asia into China” 的转述;其余原文未提。

questions.q: How do we know these shows were popular long ago?
options: Old paintings and pottery still show them.
People still perform them in schools.
The dancers wrote down their stories.
Modern films copy them exactly.
questions.explanation: 末句 “old paintings and pottery show us how popular such shows once were” 的转述(覆盖短文后半)。

units.title: Approaching Classics

lines.text: Which classic would you recommend to me?
lines.cn: 你会向我推荐哪一本经典?

lines.text: The Old Man and the Sea. It's short but very powerful.
lines.cn: 《老人与海》,它短小却非常有力。

lines.text: What do you love most about it?
lines.cn: 你最喜欢它哪一点?

lines.text: The old man never gives up, even when he loses everything.
lines.cn: 老人即便失去一切也从不放弃。

lines.text: Do you really think classics still matter today?
lines.cn: 你真的觉得经典在今天还重要吗?

lines.text: Yes. They feed both the heart and the mind.
lines.cn: 当然。它们既滋养心灵也滋养头脑。

lines.text: But some of them are quite hard to read.
lines.cn: 可有些读起来挺难的。

lines.text: I wish I had started reading them earlier. It's worth the effort.
lines.cn: 我真希望自己早点开始读它们,这份努力是值得的。

reading.passage: Hemingway is famous for his short, simple sentences. He believed that the best writing hides most of its meaning under the surface, like an iceberg. Although his words are plain, his stories carry deep feeling.
reading.passageCn: 海明威以短小、简单的句子著称。他认为最好的写作把大部分含义藏在表面之下,就像一座冰山。尽管他的用词朴素,他的故事却饱含深情。

questions.q: What is Hemingway famous for?
What did he compare good writing to?

writing.prompt: Recommend a classic book you love. Say what it is, why it is great, and how it made you feel. Try to use 'I wish…' or 'If only…' to share a wish about it.
writing.promptCn: 推荐一本你喜爱的经典:它是什么、为什么伟大、给你怎样的感受。试着用 'I wish…' 或 'If only…' 表达一个与它有关的愿望。

quizQuestions.q: The old man faced the sharks with quiet ____.（决心)
A true ____ is a book loved by readers for hundreds of years.（经典)
Reading great books deepens our ____ of beauty.（欣赏;鉴赏)
Shakespeare wrote more than 150 ____.（十四行诗)
I wish I ____ Spanish, so I could read the poems in the original now.
He wishes he ____ the novel before the exam last week.
If only I ____ those cruel words to her yesterday!
I wish our teacher ____ give us a lecture on poetry one day.
听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 这位老人保住了他的尊严。
这位老人卖掉了他的船。
这位老人忘记了那条鱼。
quizQuestions.audio: The old man kept his dignity.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 人们每年都朗诵那首诗。
quizQuestions.audio: People recite the poem every year.

opts: 一个人可以被毁灭,但不能被打败。

listeningQuestions.audio: We read poetry because we are members of the human race.
opts: 我们读诗,因为我们都是人类的一员。

listeningQuestions.audio: Su Shi wrote his famous poem on a Mid-Autumn night.
opts: 苏轼是一名画家而非诗人。

listeningQuestions.audio: Shakespeare is seen as the greatest playwright of all time.
opts: 莎士比亚是一名科学家。
莎士比亚只写过一部剧。
莎士比亚被视为有史以来最伟大的剧作家。

listeningQuestions.audio: Wordsworth often wrote about the beauty of nature.
opts: 华兹华斯常常描写大自然之美。

listeningQuestions.audio: Reading classics feeds both the heart and the mind.
opts: 读经典既滋养心灵也滋养头脑。

finalReading.passage: When Daniel first opened a thick volume of Shakespeare, the old words frightened him and he nearly closed the book for good. Instead, he read just one short scene each evening and quietly looked up the lines he did not understand. By the end of the summer, he could follow the famous monologue with ease, and he felt proud that a little daily reading had opened such a rich new world.

questions.q: What did Daniel do instead of closing the book?
options: He worked through a single scene each night and checked unfamiliar lines.
He gave up reading Shakespeare completely.
He asked a friend to read the whole play for him.
He decided to watch a film of the play instead.
questions.explanation: 原文 'read just one short scene each evening and quietly looked up the lines he did not understand' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Daniel feel by the end of the summer?
options: Bored and ready to quit reading.
Proud that steady daily reading had rewarded him.
Sorry that he had ever started the play.
As frightened of the old words as before.
questions.explanation: 末句 'felt proud that a little daily reading had opened such a rich new world'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)的转述。
